action_summary: Replaced logit pooling with an equal-weight arithmetic mixture of independently normalized model/view probabilities. The existing binary normalized-sigmoid semantics are preserved through float32 softmax(logsigmoid(logits)); the multiclass branch uses per-view float32 softmax. This targets KL divergence by reducing the influence of individual extreme logits while retaining all five checkpoints, four TTA views, architecture, preprocessing, and Kaggle paths for a focused comparison. Added a numerical probability floor and submission finiteness/row-sum checks. No training or inference was run, and improvement remains an unmeasured hypothesis without competition data.
